summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K on July 13, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the resignation of board member Dr. Paulo Fontoura following his appointment as Global Head of R&D at Sanofi. The departure is voluntary and routine rather than a forced or abrupt management change triggering a special-situation classification. The board expressed gratitude and expects to appoint a successor in due course. No financial terms, premiums, or structural mechanics are involved. This filing is an ordinary current report of a non-material board transition and does not constitute an event-driven special situation. There are no deal terms, no activist campaign, and no strategic review.
